name: TNFR1 signaling promoting canonical NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members cover TNFR1-induced NF-kappaB and proapoptotic signaling with LUBAC linear ubiquitination and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB, unlike confusables focused on negative regulation of death-receptor necrosis, TLR/IRAK-driven IKK recruitment, or non-canonical NIK signaling.

name: Receptor internalization and lysosomal degradation, LDL receptor family
rationale: Members concern endocytic uptake, reduced recycling and lysosomal catabolism of surface receptors, centred on LDLR/VLDLR clearance and its NR1H2/3 (IDOL) restraint, distinguishing it from cholesterol-sensing/SREBP and caveolar or inhibitory internalization confusables.

name: ESCRT membrane scission in MVB sorting, budding and abscission
rationale: All members are ESCRT-dependent membrane fission events (MVB/exosome biogenesis, receptor downregulation, viral budding, midbody abscission, nuclear envelope sealing), and the cytokinetic and nuclear-envelope roles separate it from the autophagy confusable.

qualifier: regulation of long-chain fatty acid uptake
name: Regulation of long-chain fatty acid uptake and beta-oxidation
rationale: Members regulate cellular long-chain fatty acid import, the carnitine shuttle and beta-oxidation, distinguishing it from lipid-droplet/triglyceride and carnitine-transport or medium-chain confusables.

core: Antimicrobial innate defense against bacteria and fungi
name: Antimicrobial peptide and granule defense against bacteria and fungi
rationale: Members are effector defenses against microbes (defensins, antimicrobial peptides, neutrophil granule cargo, metal sequestration, mucosal immunity), unlike confusables centred on respiratory burst, myeloid activation or complement.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport in osmotic and renal sodium homeostasis
rationale: Members cover cation-chloride cotransporters, regulation of Na+/K+ transport, osmotic and salt stress responses and renal sodium handling, distinguishing it from potassium-channel, sodium/proton exchanger and vasopressin-aquaporin water confusables.

name: Purinergic and lysophospholipid GPCR signaling via phospholipase C
rationale: Members concern P2Y/adenosine purinergic and LPA/S1P receptor signaling, extracellular ATP release and hydrolysis, and PLC-IP3 calcium signaling, setting it apart from prostanoid/leukotriene GPCRs and Wnt/calcium confusables.

core: Negative regulation of T cell activation
name: Peripheral T cell tolerance, anergy and suppressed activation
rationale: Members restrain T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine output and induce self-tolerance and anergy, with tolerance induction and anergy distinguishing it from Th-differentiation and broad T/NK activation confusables.

name: Cellular zinc import by ZIP transporters
rationale: All members describe zinc uptake across the plasma membrane by SLC39 (ZIP) transporters and intracellular zinc homeostasis, unlike confusables on copper/manganese transport, heavy-metal responses or metallothionein/MTF1.

name: Lands-cycle acyl-chain remodeling of glycerophospholipids
rationale: Members are acyl-chain remodeling of PC, PE, PS, PI and PG, distinguishing it from de novo phospholipid synthesis, cardiolipin, DAG/TAG and phospholipid catabolism confusables.

name: Glycosphingolipid and ganglioside catabolism
rationale: All members concern degradation of glycosphingolipids and gangliosides, distinguishing it from glycosphingolipid biosynthesis/transport and glycosaminoglycan degradation confusables.

name: Platelet activation with SNARE-dependent degranulation and cytoskeletal remodeling
rationale: Members combine platelet activation modules, platelet degranulation with SNARE disinhibition and integrin-cytoskeleton remodeling, unlike confusables on Rho/Rap integrin signaling, VWF adhesion or platelet receptor agonist signaling.

name: E2F target transcription driving G1/S transition
rationale: Members are E2F target gene sets, G1/S-specific transcription and cell-cycle modules promoting G1/S entry, distinguishing it from DNA replication, RB/CDK control and G2/M confusables.

name: Acid-base and phosphate transport in organelle pH and mineralization
rationale: Members cover V-ATPase organelle acidification, bicarbonate/carbonic anhydrase pH control, Na+/Pi cotransport and its disorders, and enamel/dentin mineralization, distinguishing it from SLC26 anion exchange, sodium/proton exchanger and FGF23/PTH bone confusables.

core: Muscle adaptation and cell size regulation
qualifier: skeletal muscle atrophy, growth and regeneration
name: Skeletal muscle mass adaptation: atrophy, growth and regeneration
rationale: Members concern skeletal muscle responses to activity and inactivity, atrophy, growth, cell size and satellite-cell regeneration, distinguishing it from cardiac adaptation and calcineurin-signaling confusables.

core: Modulation of cAMP and calcium signaling
name: cAMP and calcium signaling modulation in neuron-glia communication
rationale: Members regulate adenylate cyclase signaling and calcium entry together with gap-junction and neuron-glia signaling, separating it from glutamate/adrenergic Gi-receptor and connexon-assembly confusables; the grouping is loose.

name: Mesenchymal extracellular matrix program with focal adhesion mechanosignaling
rationale: Members are ECM/collagen/TGF-beta gene modules, the EMT hallmark and a YAP/TAZ-CCN mechanoresponsive module plus focal adhesion assembly, distinguishing it from stromal-complement, integrin-migration and fibroblast-proliferation confusables.

qualifier: gp130 cytokines in autocrine and paracrine signaling
name: IL-6-family gp130 cytokine autocrine and paracrine STAT signaling
rationale: Members concern gp130 cytokines (IL-11, CNTF, LIF/OSM) and STAT-activating autocrine/paracrine signaling with inflammatory cytokine and chemokine modules, unlike IL-10/IL-12/IL-23 family and common-gamma-chain cytokine confusables.

name: Post-translational maturation of viral structural proteins
rationale: Members describe processing and maturation of coronavirus, dengue and RSV structural proteins and their assembly at the budding site, distinguishing it from viral attachment/entry and host-targeting confusables.

name: Mitochondrial genome transcription, translation and maintenance
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination, mitoribosome translation stages and mtDNA repair, distinguishing it from mitochondrial RNA stability/processing, modification and replication confusables.

name: Regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and cellular respiration
rationale: Members regulate electron transport, OXPHOS, ATP and nucleotide synthesis and ROS output, including PGC-1alpha activation, unlike confusables on oxidative-stress and hypoxia-induced cell death.

name: Early nephron and nephric duct-ureter morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, pronephros, renal vesicle, comma/S-shaped body and nephron patterning plus mesonephric duct, ureteric bud and ureter, distinguishing it from metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and distal tubule segment confusables.

name: V-ATPase-dependent lysosomal and Golgi lumen pH regulation
rationale: All members concern V-ATPase assembly and the acidification or pH setting of lysosomal and Golgi lumens, unlike confusables on melanosome pigmentation, bicarbonate/phosphate transport or NHE-driven endosomal acidification.

name: Polyamine biosynthesis, interconversion and transport
rationale: All members concern putrescine, spermidine and spermine synthesis via ODC, oxidation/interconversion and transport, distinguishing it from hypusine, ornithine/arginine, tryptophan and methionine-salvage confusables.

name: Growth plate chondrocyte hypertrophic maturation
rationale: All three members concern RUNX2-driven hypertrophic maturation of growth plate chondrocytes, distinguishing it from early chondrogenesis, osteoblast and bone mineralization confusables.
